title: Typed text in scripts the form font lacks depends on the PDF viewer
symptom: in a fillable PDF, text typed in Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Devanagari or Thai is drawn with a font the viewer picks, or saved without an appearance (Firefox) that poppler-based viewers (Evince, Okular) then draw without those characters; some viewers draw characters their font lacks as nothing or boxes, and some do not join Arabic letters; the export names each field already holding such text
workaround: fill those values in the Word document before exporting, or use Acrobat Reader or Preview, which substitute fonts and shape Arabic
